trace.final:
All done. Here's a summary of what I did:

**Diagnosis:** checkout-api's latest production deploy (v2.3.1) was failing health checks across all three regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an ~18% error rate. The most recent release that was healthy in production was v2.3.0.

**Remediation:**
1. Rolled back to v2.3.0 — the first attempt only partially completed (us-east only, orchestrator error), so I retried it.
2. The retry succeeded: all three regions are now running v2.3.0.
3. Verified the service is healthy again — status is healthy with error rate down to ~0.2%.

**Incident:** Opened SEV2 incident **INC-0002** for checkout-api ("checkout-api rolled back to v2.3.0 after v2.3.1 health check failures"), documenting the rollout, the partial rollback failure and retry, and the current healthy state. On-call has been paged.
